title: The MonkeVerse Official Modpack
description: Modpack with optimizations for The Monkeverse!
body:
# Hey, this is the official modpack for The Monkeverse!
If you don't know what it is, it's basically just a survival minecraft server, and this modpack just optimizes the experience a bit with a few extras.
The server has a [Discord](https://discord.gg/FtJRM5B9) (recommended but not required to join).
And, if you just want to join regularly (Even though it's highly recommended to join the discord because it has the rules, along with a [reddit post](https://www.reddit.com/r/MinecraftServer/comments/1jkx8g0/the_monkeverse_ip_themonkeverseaternosme_survival/) which is pretty neat), the server IP is: the-monkeverse.aternos.me

### Have fun! :D
